verdict.rationale: Gecko's docs describe automated 'Request fix' PRs and suggested patches for vulnerabilities found via source-to-sink call-chain analysis, which appears oriented at custom-code exploits (SAST-style) rather than dependency/package version issues; there is no mention of dependency manifests, package upgrade paths, or SCA-specific remediation anywhere in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: any documentation of scanning package manifests (package.json, requirements.txt, etc.), suggesting version upgrades, or handling transitive dependency CVEs.
